text: We don’t have enough evidence to determine if this asset lost tree cover since 2020. The analysis couldn’t be completed because the required satellite data for this area wasn’t available. Key datasets like Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, and MGAP 2021 weren’t prepared for this asset, so no observations were made. This means we can’t confirm whether tree-cover loss occurred, didn’t occur, or assess compliance with regulations like EUDR. Further data collection would be needed to answer this question.
